data.one_liner: Extremely fast NoSQL database for Flutter with static typing and asynchronous queries.
data.what_it_does: Provides a NoSQL database for Flutter and Dart applications with support for composite indexes, full-text search, and real-time database watchers. It uses code generation via build_runner to define typed collections and queries.
use_when: You need a high-performance local NoSQL database for your Flutter or desktop application
You want compile-time checked queries and static typing for database operations
You require real-time updates through collection and query watchers
avoid_when: You prefer an SQL database solution like SQLite or Drift
You want a database that works entirely without code generation
strengths: Very fast query and insert performance
Full-text search and embedded object support
Real-time database watchers for collections and queries
weaknesses: Community fork requiring manual setup of multiple packages like isar_community_flutter_libs and isar_community_generator
data.setup_notes: Requires adding isar_community, isar_community_flutter_libs, isar_community_generator, and build_runner to pubspec, and running build_runner for code generation.

alternatives.name: hive_ce
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want a lightweight NoSQL key-value database alternative.

alternatives.name: drift
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer a robust, type-safe SQLite database over a NoSQL solution.

alternatives.name: sqflite
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a standard, lightweight SQLite database for Flutter.
